initialization.procedure: original set_seed immediately before full AGTv3 construction, then load only Stage-1 non-controller weights; clone fresh controller to U/T

gradient_policy.policy: unchanged run_diff_sequence full-sequence BPTT; no token/state/cache detach; reset at independent-sequence boundary
gradient_policy.horizon: entire current sequence: 4..16 tokens in training; no inter-sequence graph
production_detach_locations: src/routing.py:137 hard - relaxed.detach() + relaxed; ST relaxed stop-gradient
gradient_policy.unused_detach: src/convergence.py detach helper is outside execute_differentiable
gradient_policy.clone_semantics: state.clone, cache.clone and memory write clones preserve autograd
gradient_policy.attention: GQA retains complete sequence; SWA window 256 retains 255 committed rows; no within-sequence eviction at these lengths
gradient_policy.convolution: GDN retains conv_kernel-1=3 inputs; existing finite convolution receptive field, no added gradient detach
gradient_policy.frozen_computations: T frozen backbone executes with autograd enabled
gradient_policy.diagnostic_detaches: copy/snapshot/probability/report tensors only; returned execution/final CE graph is not replaced
gradient_policy.anchor: original Prelude h_t,0 is passed unchanged to all successor blocks; observed for in-flight mutation

execution.stochastic: unchanged hard-forward ST-Gumbel with all ten candidates, nine speculative bank calls per decision

inputs.rejection_rule: reject exact training/prior recorded input match, panel duplicate, or filled parity quota; accept in generator order
inputs.final_panel_usage: sealed before outcomes; only evaluated after update1040; no checkpoint selection

randomness.derivation: four integer seeds from CPU torch.Generator(4704), in recorded order
randomness.training_coordinate: epoch/sequence ID/token/decision/ten successor action slots; new sealed uniforms on every visit
randomness.pairing: same visit/tape coordinates in U and T regardless of decision counts
randomness.fifteen_positions: legal P=8 maximum D coverage; not a stopping cap
randomness.injection: reuse diagnostic-only IndexedNoise hook around original torch.rand_like; original ST math unchanged
randomness.reconstruction: original masked log-softmax + clamped uniforms + Gumbel/tau softmax reconstructs every sampled hard action

snapshots.development: deterministic U/T diagnostics on existing exposed validation/OOD panel at each snapshot; no updates/selection

modes: four paired fixed ST-Gumbel tapes for U/T
final_evaluation.aggregate: equal-weight pooling over all four tapes, with each tape also reported

strong_criterion: valid execution/finite optimization; T deterministic accuracy=1 on both fresh splits, higher accuracy and lower CE than U in both deterministic splits and both aggregate sampled splits
stopping: mechanical violation or nonfinite only; ordinary performance failure continues through exactly1040 updates
limitations: single controller-training initialization; four tapes replicate sampling, not controller seeds
fresh final inputs exclude exact available recorded training/prior input matches; unknown Stage-1 training inputs and unretained historical probes cannot be excluded
prior-input exclusion is conservative and also excludes recoverable historical training arrays
development panel was previously exposed and is used only at fixed snapshots; final panel is not used for selection
fixed frozen backbone specialized for canonical routing; no architecture or backbone adaptation
